Deleting an auth user cascades: users → progress, events
Lesson flow (numbered arrows), all over HTTPS
1
Student signs in; Auth returns a JWT,
kept in the session store.
2
App reads the lesson path, progress, level and
streak via REST; RLS returns only their rows.
3
Opening a lesson calls log_event(); the user
comes from the JWT and repeats are ignored.
4
At the end, the app sends the answers + JWT
(never a score or XP) to complete-lesson.
5
complete_lesson() locks the row, grades, and
writes XP, streak, unlock and progress in one
transaction; the result goes back to the app.
Delete account: delete-account removes the auth user;
the cascade deletes the profile, progress and events.
The app can't write any table directly, so progress can't be faked.
